sum: Beazer Homes USA, Inc. operates as a homebuilder in the United States. The company designs, constructs, and sells single-family, condominiums, villas, and duets homes under the Beazer Homes, Gatherings, and Choice Plans brands. It also sells its homes through commissioned new home sales counselors and independent realtors. Beazer Homes USA, Inc. was founded in 1985 and is headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia.
ceo: Mr. Allan P. Merrill (Chairman, President & CEO)
